[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Obsidian, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B on task N (Task Card ⇧B) opens a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Blocks… stage where Bryan picks the open tasks T that N blocks. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Applying it writes N onto each T's Depends-On line. The bytes are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly what Ctrl+Shift+B on T adding N would write: T becomes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Blocked, its live links in today's Pomodoros are consumed, N takes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]over its lane, and N's BLOCKS mirror is updated. The stage previews[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]every consequence before ↵, and BLOCKS chips gain ＋ / ×.[/#D7D7AF]
